text: Stepping into this modern, angular space, I sense a paradox of anticipation and stillness. The controlled lighting and glass walls invite curiosity, yet the absence of people emphasizes a contemplative quietness. Passing through into the vibrant exhibition, the stimulating visuals and bold "R+D" lettering prompt me to reflect on the nature of progress and inquiry. I feel both inspired by the promise of innovation and aware of my own smallness within the grand experiment of human knowledge.
